resources.string: From a photograph to a mathematical animation.
Soon you will be able to transform your photos into strokes drawn by moving circles.
Photo import and camera capture will be enabled in a later development stage.
Test a sample or import an image
Auto and Drawing protect facial features and combine them with hair and silhouette. Subject processes objects and pets. Check the overlay and complete result.
A contour was found. Check whether it matches your subject.
No reliable strokes found. Try another profile or a closer photo with a simpler background.
The image could not be processed. Try another image.
Mathematical demonstration with a known contour.
Each stroke has its own epicircles. The pen lifts between separate features. More components refine the detected strokes.
Image imported, but contour processing failed. Try a different image.
Portrait: %1$d strokes. Eyes, nose and mouth protected. Check likeness in the complete result.
Subject and details: %1$d strokes. Check that the outline matches your subject.
Detected lines: %1$d strokes. Check features and line continuity.
The subject model is not available yet. Connect to the Internet and retry so Google Play services can download it. Drawing works without that model.
Settings changed. Tap retry to process the photo.
The animation appears after strokes have been detected in this image.
Sensitivity adjusts hair, silhouette and details. Facial features are preserved independently of that filter.
Partial portrait: %1$d strokes. Some reliable facial features are missing. Try a closer or more frontal photo.
Simple keeps fewer lines; Fine includes more detail and may add texture. Tap retry to apply.
Structure seeks main shapes and reduces texture. Texture keeps more fine lines. Tap retry to apply.
Photo crop; adjust the corners or the horizontal and vertical controls.
Drag the corners to crop or the center to move the crop. You can also use the controls below.
You can rotate and crop the photo before processing it.
Camera access was not granted. You can choose a photo or enable the permission in your phone settings.
The camera could not open or capture a photo. Retry or choose a photo.
This photo needs too much memory. Try a smaller image.
The working photo could not be saved. Check the available storage and retry.
This photo stays as local work until you replace or discard it.
Contour correction canvas. Use the buttons to keep a region, erase, draw or move.
Drag a rectangle around the subject to keep only the strokes inside that region.
Drag the eraser over the segments to remove. Each gesture can be undone.
Draw over the photo to add missing lines. Each gesture creates a separate stroke.
When zoomed in, drag to move the image and reach other details.
No reliable silhouette is available. Use Details or draw a correction.
Apply saves corrections with this photo. Cancel keeps the previous result.
Clean or complete the contour before animating it, including when detection found no strokes.
Corrected contour: %1$d strokes. Review the complete result.
The contour is empty. Open Edit contours to restore it or add lines.
You reached 100 corrections. Undo or restore detection to continue.
Seek to review a point: playback will pause. Expand the view to zoom and move the drawing.
Pinch to zoom and drag to move the drawing. Reset framing centers it again.
Fourier animation. Use the controls to pause, change speed and review the drawing.
Draws once within the chosen duration and holds the result at the end. This duration replaces the player speed. MP4 has no audio.
Uses the player’s strokes, components, colour, background and epicycles. The frame shown here is exported. PNG contains the completed drawing.
File ready to save or share.
Could not create the file. Check available storage, or try PNG or GIF if the device cannot encode MP4.
Not enough memory. Try a smaller resolution or close other apps.
File saved to the chosen location.
Could not save. Check storage and choose an available location.
Could not open the share menu. You can save the file.
Save the result to keep it. Temporary files may be removed after 24 hours.
You can return home and resume this crop. After applying, review the contours before animating.
Up to %1$d components per stroke · %2$d strokes
Processing the photo… This may take a few seconds.
Choose a close, sharp photo with a simple background. You can crop it and correct the strokes afterwards.
Your photograph and crop are saved on this device.
Resume reviewing your photo and its contours.
Discover how circles draw a shape.
Your photos are processed on this device. No accounts or ads.
From a photograph to moving strokes, step by step.
Take a photo or choose one from your phone. You can also explore with a demo shape. Only one working photo is kept at a time.
Crop closer to the subject and rotate if needed. Drag the corners or use the crop controls. Next applies your changes and finds strokes.
Check that the strokes represent your subject. Change the profile and Retry, or open Correct contours to erase, keep a region or draw lines. If nothing is detected, you can still draw a correction.
Adjust components, speed, colour, background and circles in Parameters and style. More components reproduce the detected lines more accurately; they cannot recover features that were not detected.
Pause, restart or move the progress slider to inspect the drawing. Expand view lets you zoom and pan. Show complete result displays all strokes.
Choose PNG for the complete drawing, or GIF/MP4 for animation. Check the square or vertical frame and create the file. Then Save to keep it, or Share to open the Android menu.

Use good lighting, a simple background and a large subject. For portraits, an unobstructed front-facing face helps. A busy or textured photo may need cropping or manual correction. A likeness is not guaranteed for every image.
The Subject profile may need Google Play services to download a model on first use. The photo is not sent to our services. If the model is unavailable, use Drawing or correct the contours manually.

The original photo, crop and corrections of the current work are saved in private app storage. They are replaced when you choose another photo or demo. Discard the photo to delete that work. Files saved outside the app remain in your chosen location.
No photograph is saved. Demo shapes are not personal photos.
One working photo is kept with its crop and corrections. Resume it from Home.
Fourier series and epicycles for animated drawings. Local processing, no account and no payments.
The shape will replace the working photo and its corrections. Export first if you want to keep the result.
The photo saved in the app, its crop and corrections will be deleted. Files already saved outside the app are kept.
PNG: complete drawing · GIF: animated loop · MP4: silent video
